context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 81 tested 3 new features: (1) Reports Centre - GET /api/reports/summary/{property_id}?period=month returns consolidated data (bookings, maintenance, registrations, satisfaction, POS, loyalty). CSV exports at GET /api/reports/export/{property_id}/{type} for bookings, maintenance, registrations, pos, satisfaction. Frontend panel under Operations with period selector, summary cards, revenue/operations sections, export buttons. (2) Online Booking Widget - Public endpoints: GET /api/booking-widget/info/{property_id}, POST /api/booking-widget/check-availability, POST /api/booking-widget/book. Frontend at /book/{property_id} with 4-step flow (search, results, details, confirmation). (3) Housekeeping-Maintenance Integration - POST /api/housekeeping/report-maintenance creates maintenance issue with source='housekeeping', SLA based on priority, department based on category. Photo upload at POST /api/housekeeping/upload-maintenance-photo/{issue_id}. Frontend has 'Maintenance' button in Housekeeping panel and 'Report Issue' dialog in Maintenance panel.
